categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.name: 40 Orb
categories.rules:
- Timing starts when first movement is possible.

- Timing ends when Ripto's health bar drops to zero at the end of phase 3.

- Skipping into Crush's Dungeon, Gulp's Overlook, or Ripto's Arena is not allowed.

- Timing starts when first movement is possible.

- Timing ends when Ripto's health bar drops to zero at the end of phase 3 or when the last item has been collected.
